mapper.sql: question_id, account_id, collection_id, request_id, subject, body_markdown, summary, created_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO question (account_id, request_id, subject, body_markdown, summary) VALUES (#{question.accountId}, #{question.requestId}, #{question.subject}, #{question.bodyMarkdown}, #{question.summary}) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uk_question_account_request DO NOTHING RETURNING question_id
mapper.sql: COALESCE((SELECT a.state FROM question_answer a WHERE a.account_id = question.account_id AND a.question_id = question.question_id), 'NOT_STARTED') AS answer_state
mapper.select: SELECT , FROM question WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND request_id = #{requestId}
SELECT , FROM question WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND question_id = #{questionId}
SELECT question_id, collection_id, subject, summary, created_at, FROM question WHERE ORDER BY created_at DESC, question_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET collection_id = #{collectionId,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND question_id = #{questionId}
